title: Navo-enquête 1967
descriptions: Opinions and information on NATO / political information / perception of communist threat / opinions on undemocratic NATO members / should the Netherlands remain a member of NATO. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
